summary: P1 (spec fidelity) atip.claiml2.20 describes a check this change deleted. Its Then: an agreement check over the declared minor, the fixture's contractVersion and the --contract of the job atip and the recipes atip and atip-deep finds a value lowered to 1.3 by name and flags a job that gives no minor. c6dde67b6 removed --contract from the job and both recipes (a job that gives no minor is now the intended state) and deleted minor_problems/contracts_in with atip_claim14_13 and atip_claim15_11. Brief I10 retires their scenarios but not this one, which has been bound to atip_claim14_13 since the 0.41 review. Its evidence is now atip_claim15_10, which asserts only fixture contractVersion == DECLARED_MINOR and tree meta.contractVersion == DECLARED_MINOR: no seeded lowering, no job or recipe, nothing named. Signing it would pin a verdict about a check that no longer exists. Fix: retire atip.claiml2.20 with the other I10 scenarios (what survives of it is atip.claim15.10), or reword it to the fixture/tree agreement, which duplicates claim15.10. Blast radius: no code; the gate counts atip-contract as covered by a scenario whose text contradicts the shipped CI job.
